title: html2lvgl registry export
description: Every component definition's props, slots and signals, as produced by `html2lvgl --export-registry` (src/registry-export.mjs). Version 1.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped when the shape changes. A consumer should refuse a version it does not know.

components.description: In the registry's offer order (core first, then plugins in load order); that order breaks match-score ties. Names are unique.

widgets.description: Names `data-lv-widget` accepts that the converter maps straight to one LVGL widget. A component of the same name, if any, is named in `component`.

name.description: The value of `data-lv-widget` that forces this component.

source.description: "core" for definitions that ship with html2lvgl; "plugin:<name>" for a loaded plugin's; "custom" for a registry built by hand.

overrides.description: True for a plugin definition that replaced the core definition of the same name (it sets `override: true`).

description.description: One line for a palette tooltip; null when the definition has none.

leaf.description: True when nothing inside the matched node is recognized separately.

props.description: In the order a property panel should show them. Names are unique.

slots.description: Names of the places children can go. Unique.

signals.description: Behavior state the component declares: LVGL subjects and animation timelines. Empty for a static component.

default.description: A value of `type` (a color is a string); null only when the definition has no default.

enum.description: The only values the prop takes; absent when it is free-form.

name.description: The suffix of the emitted name: `<screen>_<key>_<name>`.

lvgl.description: The LVGL XML tag the converter emits for it.

component.description: The component with the same name, or null.
